data.title: 焰影苇草 · 整理发辫
data.description: 一边的发辫松了，她对着镜子重新编好，最后将丝带系在发尾。
data.promptProse: Standing before an antique wooden dressing table, Reed ties a rich red ribbon around the tip of her neatly woven hair braid. Her focused reflection appears in the tilted oval mirror, flanked by an ornate hairpin dish and cut-glass bottles under clear morning light.
data.animaCaption: Holding the ribbon ends between deft fingers, she ties a neat knot at the base of her braid, checking the symmetry in the mirror's reflection.
